meta.name: Outcast 720p
meta.description:
Kyle Barnes has been plagued by possession since he was a child. Now an adult, he embarks on a spiritual journey to find answers, but what he uncovers could mean the end of life on Earth as we know it.

Rated TV-MA · Canceled · First aired 3 Jun 2016 · United States of America · Language: English · 50 min
Studio: Fox International Channels, Circle of Confusion · Network: Cinemax

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: A Darkness Surrounds Him
videos.overview: Kyle Barnes confronts a possession case and begins to delve into the secrets of his past.

videos.title: (I Remember) When She Loved Me
videos.overview: Kyle questions his family history.

videos.title: All Alone Now
videos.overview: Kyle and Reverend Anderson confront an unusual possession.

videos.title: A Wrath Unseen
videos.overview: The intrigue intensifies in town as Anderson uncovers startling news about someone close to him. Megan holds fast to her secret.

videos.title: The Road Before Us
videos.overview: Kyle presses his estranged wife, Allison, to meet; a suspicious Chief Giles shadows his best friend.

videos.title: From The Shadows It Watches
videos.overview: Rev. Anderson finds his powers sorely tested; Patricia reaches out to Kyle; Sidney delivers a warning.

videos.title: The Damage Done
videos.overview: Kyle and Allison revisit their past; Rev. Anderson gets carried away during Remembrance Day.

videos.title: What Lurks Within
videos.overview: Rev. Anderson finds himself increasingly alienated; Kyle has a stunning revelation from Sidney.

videos.title: Close to Home
videos.overview: Kyle enlists Mark's help to find out where Allison has gone; Anderson fights to keep his grip on his church and the town.

videos.title: This Little Light
videos.overview: Rev. Anderson resorts to drastic measures in an attempt to finally rid the town of the devil.

videos.title: Bad Penny
videos.overview: Kyle finds the possession phenomenon to be more widespread than he had imagined, while Reverend Anderson struggles with guilt over his actions.

videos.title: The Day After That
videos.overview: The mystery of the supernatural manifestations and why they are drawn to Kyle continues. As the possessions grow, Kyle struggles to protect those he holds most dear.

videos.title: Not My Job to Judge
videos.overview: Megan must face the consequences of her actions. Meanwhile, a disappearance in Rome leads Kyle and Anderson to a new and dangerous consequence of the rise in possessions.

videos.title: The One I'd Be Waiting For
videos.overview: A dangerous fugitive on the loose threatens the town of Rome, as well as Reverend Anderson’s sanity. Kyle struggles with a new understanding of where his powers – and his curse – originated. Megan and Holly attempt to rebuild their lives

videos.title: The Common Good
videos.overview: Kyle gets closer to finding Sidney, while Anderson discovers an unexpected potential ally. A prominent member of the Rome community is revealed to be an agent of the possessed, and few characters will escape his plan unscathed.

videos.title: Fireflies
videos.overview: Kyle's family and friends mourn the aftermath of a disaster – until a revelation from Reverend Anderson compels them to use Amber's unique powers. Allison rejoins her family in Rome.

videos.title: Alone When It Comes
videos.overview: Kyle attempts to get his family to safety as the town of Rome becomes increasingly overrun by the possessed. Anderson takes Megan under his wing, bringing her to find solace in an unlikely place. Chief Giles realizes his wife has been resorting to desperate measures.

videos.title: Mercy
videos.overview: Kyle faces the mysteries behind his powers. Reverend Anderson finally confronts Sidney as Doctor Park's plans grow in scale. Megan makes an unlikely friend – one who will prove dangerous. Chief Giles tries to defend himself and his wife from the tide of the possessed in Rome.

videos.title: This is How It Starts
videos.overview: Kyle and Anderson face down Sidney – until an unexpected threat intervenes. Megan leaves the relative safety of the backwoods church, and danger quickly finds her. Tragedy strikes the Giles family. An unexpected stranger rivets Kyle's attention.

videos.title: To the Sea
videos.overview: Kyle reluctantly joins forces with a mysterious stranger in an attempt to end the possession threat once and for all, but fears the man may be hiding something. Megan struggles to escape her captors. Reverend Anderson shares an unexpected source of strength with his old friend, Chief Giles.
